goal: Implement the missing runtime discovery, tiered assignment, and exhaustion re-tiering required by phase 1, with the campaign routing policy of Luna workers, Sol reviewers, and Astra judges.

definitionOfDone.text: doctor --discover [--json] reports each installed driver and model as {available, exhaustedUntil, reason}; provider exhaustion is normalized per driver, including Z.ai code 1310 with its reset timestamp, and an absent CLI is reported absent rather than failed.

Runtimes carry a tier beside their resolved vendor; explicit runtimes and defaults are preserved, omitted assignments compose a cheapest available worker and strongest available cross-vendor judge, and the chosen assignment is persisted for audit.

Provider exhaustion re-tiers within the same tier only when the replacement remains admissible against the judge that will actually run; otherwise the node reaches attention with exhaustedUntil and never silently descends to a weaker or same-vendor runtime.

taskPacket.objective: Implement runtime discovery, tiered role assignment, and same-tier exhaustion re-tiering that the previous recovery run left missing.
instructions: Inspect the current implementation and the failed p1d-recovery evidence before editing. Build on the existing resolved-vendor and runtimes[].fallback architecture; do not restore runtimeRules.

Add doctor --discover [--json] and normalize provider availability per driver. Cover Z.ai code 1310 reset timestamps, Codex quota/auth failures, Claude quota/auth failures, and absent CLIs without live network calls in tests.

Add runtime tiers and explicit-vs-composed assignment. Explicit runtimes and runtimeDefaults must remain unchanged; omitted assignments choose the cheapest available worker and strongest available judge from a different resolved vendor, or fail with a named error. Persist the composed assignment in run state.

Implement exhaustion re-tiering within the same tier, preserving vendor admissibility against the actual judge. If no candidate exists, transition to attention with exhaustedUntil. Keep explicit single-hop fallback precedence and do not silently switch providers for budget, scope, permission, or authority failures.
Prefer focused modules over growing runner.mjs. Add named tests for every behavior and update only the relevant contract/operations documentation.

Before declaring the work done, run every command proof in the Definition of Done — npm run check and npm run typecheck — in the foreground, with output bounded by | tail -n 200. Do not run commands in the background or use sleep loops.
Do not modify .runs/control or .runs/campaigns and do not commit. Write the canonical worker result file designated by the controller.
decisions: Explicit operator runtime declarations are always honored; discovery composes only omitted assignments.
Judge selection must remain cross-vendor against the worker runtime actually used.
Exhaustion re-tiers within the same tier and otherwise reports attention with exhaustedUntil.
nonGoals: integration transaction, worktrees, and scheduling changes
